gather_K_data_from_paged_buffer: gather K (key) fp8 data from a paged KV cache buffer using Triton or torch indexing
gather_S_scale_from_paged_buffer: gather S (scale) fp32 scale data from a paged KV cache buffer using Triton or torch indexing
gather_K_and_S_in_single_pass: gather both K and S data from a paged buffer in a single fused Triton kernel call
write_K_data_to_paged_buffer: write K (key) fp8 data to a paged KV cache buffer using torch flat indexing
write_K_and_S_to_paged_buffer: write both K and S data to a paged KV cache buffer in a single Triton kernel call
